review: B0e readiness: runner static review and checker correction

scope.runner: static read and PowerShell AST parse only
scope.checker: review, minimal correction and synthetic tests

runner.verdict: Static readiness PASS: the selected world is allowlisted and bound into the host argument list; existing process, client, dialog, deadline, restore and teardown guards remain in the reviewed runner. No UI or process experiment was performed.

checker.finding: The B0e CLI called the B0d parser but bypassed the B0d CLI lifecycle checks, so complete synthetic endpoint streams could pass without host OBSERVATION_END or confirmed EDIT_STABLE.
checker.correction: The B0e CLI now requires the exact 120-sample OBSERVATION_END marker, exactly one EDIT_REQUESTED and EDIT_STABLE marker, and at least five seconds between the latter two before reporting readiness.
checker.resultBoundary: PLAYER2_SPAWN_RADIO_OBSERVED still proves only stable assignment, local VoN/gadget components and an observed radio. It does not prove PTT, radio-path selection, pair suppression, delivery or audible sound. Runner stdout cleanup and guard summaries remain operator evidence outside this checker.
